data.name: Joseph
data.gender_notes: Joseph is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yosef, from the root y-s-p, 'to add' (Genesis 30:24). Its root is Hebrew y-s-p. Joseph, son of Jacob; Joseph, husband of Mary. Joseph is a Hebrew name meaning “He will add; God increases”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Joseph expresses “He will add; God increases”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yosef, from the root y-s-p, 'to add' (Genesis 30:24).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joseph total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Joseph?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Joseph is 1 (ruling planet Sun). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Sunday is the traditional association for Joseph. This is interpretive.

faq.a: Ruby is the traditional association for Joseph. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Joseph?
faq.a: Gold, Orange are the traditional associations for Joseph. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Joseph?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joseph total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Joseph?
faq.a: The meaning of Joseph carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.a: Joseph is recorded as a christian name meaning “He will add; God increases”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Joseph?
faq.a: In English, Joseph is rendered as “He will add; God increases”.

faq.q: Is Joseph suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Joseph is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.

faq.a: Joseph is the full recorded form; any short forms are listed in the nicknames field.

faq.q: Which culture uses the name Joseph?
faq.a: Joseph is used in Hebrew naming traditions.

faq.q: Does Joseph have a positive meaning?
faq.a: Joseph carries the meaning “He will add; God increases”.
